guide_findings: Read flows behind findings with `teapot flows list has:finding`.
List open findings with duplicates grouped and severity counts.
Show one finding with location, confidence and evidence flow IDs.
Dismiss a non-problem with a reason; it remains dismissed when rediscovered.
Gate CI using `findings list --fail-on high` (exit 3 if an open high-or-worse finding remains).
Print the smallest stored reproduction as Teapot and curl commands.
Use `findings repro --verify` to send once; verdicts are reproduces, fixed, changed or blocked.
After human review, mark fixed with a reason.
Reopen a finding with a reason if closure was wrong or the fix did not hold.
Export a redacted Markdown report for approved test stakeholders.

list.role: Ranked lead page; default state open; follow-up command included.

show.role: Endpoint, point, rule details, raised flows and follow-up; values opts out of the print-time mask.

dismiss.role: Hide one lead, a rule on an endpoint, or a rule everywhere.

promote.role: Create a tentative info finding with source lead and the lead flows as evidence.

list.role: Grouped by check and point by default; severity counts and optional CI exit 3 gate.

show.role: Full finding detail including evidence, reproduction and lifecycle.

reopen.role: Reopen a dismissed or fixed finding.

repro.role: Print a complete repro; verify sends it once and reports reproduces, fixed, changed or blocked.

export.role: Export a redacted report by default; evidence bodies are optional.

checks.mapping_basis: The built-in scan sends the endpoint flow as its recorded owner, as each other named session and anonymously. It records a finding only when another session gets the same response while the anonymous or another-session control is denied/different; a public endpoint does not fire. This directly measures cross-principal read access.

web-authz/private-object-read.required_semantics: An owner and distinct other principal read an object; anonymous and owner controls distinguish allowed/public or missing-object results from cross-principal exposure.

web-authz/forbidden-state-change.required_semantics: A distinct other or anonymous principal attempts a controlled write against a fresh object; the owner-side read must observe the treatment canary while controls establish the write/read path.
